title: G 500
subtitle: Mercedes-Benz W463 · 2002–2008 (US)

tiles.label: THE LAYOUT
tiles.text: Ladder frame, solid axles, three locking diffs

tiles.label: THE ENGINE
tiles.text: 5.0 M113 V8, the first regular-production V8 G

buy: Early electrical faults mostly gone. 2007–08 add the 7-speed, HID lamps and a camera.
avoid: Seat motors, window regulators, door-lock and transfer-case actuators.
checks: Oil at the front of the V (filter housing gasket)
Gear oil behind the front wheels (axle seals)
All three lockers on a loose surface
VIN and data card match the badges
owner: Hank's 2007: the oil filter housing gasket has been the biggest issue, and the lockers need bleeding or new lines.
